title: Chameleon Mod V2
description: Similar to the original Chameleon Mod but is made for a different version and has many more features: including tools and entities.
body:
This is a second chameleon mod but made much better including using 1.21.1

Features Include:
- Tools ( Sword, Pickaxe, Hammer, Axe, Shovel, Hoe )
- Armor ( Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots )
- Better Incubator ( with UI )
- Chameleon Entity
- Chameleon Capture Device
and more!

All Tools are similar to iron tools but with more durability.
The Armor set when sneaking makes you and the armor go invisible.

Chameleons naturally spawn in jungle biomes, and have a chance of dropping scales used to make tools.
